main_measure.name: mean excess 5-bar forward return of cases with forecast >= 2 (vs coin mean on the same grid)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 and supporting difference > 0; reject if t <= -2; at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess of cases above median forecast minus below median

decided_by: t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive whatever the supporting check shows.
reading: The coin's mean is taken over every grid bar with a full 5-bar return in all its windows, cases are grid bars with forecast >= 2 and a full return inside the window, cases equal to the median forecast are left out of the supporting split, and fewer than 30 cases gives 'not observable' as the workflow requires.
